newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Treasurer Peters welcomes New Zealand easing.
newsitem.headline: Treasurer Peters welcomes New Zealand easing.

text.p: New Zealand Treasurer Winston Peters said on Tuesday he was pleased with announcements from the Reserve Bank of New Zealand has accepted easier monetary conditions, and that the bank welcomed its new Policy Targets Agreement.

"Overall the governor (Don Brash) is accepting the easing in conditions that have followed the coalition announcement which is pleasing for exporters and home owners," Peters, who was appointed Treasurer last week, said in a statement.
Peters said he would not be in the habit of responding to Reserve Bank announcements and "the precise level (of conditions) is a matter of day-to-day management which is the governor's business".
